reviewedJoints.finding: MATCH: supervisor supplies argv RPC decimalport/identity/listen (argc>=4), fresh token and parentPID. It excludes validator key env names from child but retains the two explicit submission-plan controls. Shim performs no signing/key access, reserves result before RPC, removes only its two test controls, then execv realP2p preserving arguments1..argc-1. PID stays same across exec; /proc child exe and parent exe assertions are compatible.
reviewedJoints.joint: supervisor context and real P2P exec

reviewedJoints.finding: MATCH: six envelope fields chainId/genesisHash/consensusIdentity/forkDigest/kind/ssz; proposer_slashing enabled by Capella profile, SSZ416 bytes/hex834 chars; AltairWireKind proposer ordinal6. Fresh action, shim and receipt ledger all hash byte6||SSZ using 0x-prefixed SHA256. This is Nano IPC/protocol framing, not Ethereum gossip compatibility.
reviewedJoints.joint: wire envelope, proposer discriminant and payload digest

reviewedJoints.finding: MATCH: Jobs exact session/highWater/jobs, initially empty, highWater canonicalhex; nextsequence high+1. Pending exact4 fields sequence/payloadDigest/cancelRequested/state; completed adds decision. Accepted means decisionaccepted and cancelRequestedfalse. Forget returns the completed5-field view before removing it. No retry of lost Submit is performed.

MATCH: event exact8 fields event/accepted/receiptSha256/receiptBytes/authExported/newSignaturesCreated/execPending/productionQualified; receipt exact8 fields format/campaignId/owner/kind/actionSha256/session/sequence/job; job exact5 completed fields.
